failures.criterion: The root closes only after its last open child is done or parked — and closes the moment that child leaves (spec: 'The root closes the moment its last open child leaves the workflow'). The spec's hazard section claims a push is 'the one door' that still moves a merged root waiting in awaiting_merge; a pull request opened from the root's branch during the wait is a second one.
failures.evidence: A merged root waiting for its child, then a GitHub `opened` event for a new pull request (another number) from the same branch legion/<root>: pullRequestOpened (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/pullrequest.go:30-69) replaces the recorded merged pull request with the new open one, so the merge the root waits on is erased. When the last child is then parked, closeAwaitingRoot (linger.go:185) reads pr.State != merged and returns: the root stays in awaiting_merge forever, holding its admission slot and its six workers, and the boot sweep (resume.go sweepMerged) skips it for the same reason; if the new pull request later merges, the root closes with its production check on the wrong pull request. Before this change the root closed at its merge, so the window did not exist; the wait makes it days long. Live: the booted daemon (run, through the implementer's own harness, -tags e2e, same PostgreSQL and nats-server) showed `D2: drove GitHub pr opened #14988314 on legion/TEST065B65D5DAE6-1 ... read back: root phase awaiting_merge pullRequest #14988314 state open` then `D3: drove Dispatch issue.updated TEST065B65D5DAE6-2 -> backlog ... read back after 10s: root phase awaiting_merge status retro slot true pullRequest #14988314 open` — FAIL: the merged root never closed after its last child left. Red test, commit 944300fecd31 on legion/INFRA-229: TestANewPullRequestFromAWaitingRootsBranchLeavesItsMergeStanding in packages/daemon/internal/workflow/merge_close_test.go; `cd packages/daemon && LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN='postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:54331/postgres?sslmode=disable' go test ./internal/workflow/ -count=1 -run TestANewPullRequestFromAWaitingRootsBranchLeavesItsMergeStanding` fails with `merge_close_test.go:485: phase = "awaiting_merge", want "done"`. The test pins the outcome only (the root closes on #42 at merge, its slot freed), not a fix shape.
